title: Dračí Historie
reason: The original NoSense developer site explicitly releases the game under GNU GPL v2 and publishes both playable archives and source materials. The English 2012 author-hosted game ZIP has been independently pinned by Gentoo and verified by Abandonware against both that SHA-512 and ScummVM's English INIT.DFW detector. Production is intentionally blocked until the original source-code, complete asset/source, and MIDI archives are hash-pinned, re-audited in pinned mode, and preserved with provenance.
